featureFlagDisposition.noFlagReason: The change modifies release-disclosure manual evidence and release-doctor validation, not runtime product behavior.

changedBehavior: Vaporize v0.0.1 now carries a user manual at release/v0.0.1/user-manual.md.
Every Vaporize brochure must sit beside an audience packet and user manual before it is considered publication-shaped.
The manual documents quick start, core commands, releaseIdentity and Sparkle boundaries, review checklist, and troubleshooting.
Release doctor requires user-manual.md as a release artifact, checks manual contract tokens, checks the all-brochures gate token, and requires a launch-review evidence reference.
The public brochure marketing site links to the manual and reports the updated 108/108 release-doctor check count after the Carrie CMO gate-owner expansion.
